explanation: Available = 13 - (6+3+2) = 2. Need: P1=5, P2=2, P3=6. Only P2 can be satisfied (needs 2). After P2 completes, releases 3, available=5. Then P1 can be satisfied (needs 5). After P1, releases 6, available=11. Then P3 can be satisfied. So safe sequence P2, P1, P3.
